posts.text: Get your first hands-on experience with #RBRadiance at Pre-Rift events, starting October 16! Check out the event locator at PlayRiftbound.com today to find your nearest store. Here's what to expect from a Pre-Rift: https://playriftbound.com/.../preparing-for-the-radiance.../

France, we're coming to you! We're heading to #PGW2026, bringing exclusive activities and merch for players at our booth! On se voit à Paris ! 🇫🇷 More event details in the article: https://riot.com/4ylrL9f
